title: Lowe’s CEO Marvin Ellison on launch of the 'Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition'

Lowe’s CEO Marvin Ellison on launch of the 'Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition'
Lowe’s chairman and CEO Marvin Ellison joins 'Squawk Box' to discuss the launch of the 'Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition' with a number of America's largest companies to train and develop 1 million workers, the company's quarterly earnings results, state of the consumer, and more.
